title: [ruling C] revert PR #18971 — the 12 MiB declaration-text snapshot comes out; consumer compilation against spec@main becomes the shape gate
body:
## Maintainer ruling — recorded verbatim

Presented by the `domain:skills` seat in its chat with the maintainer on 2026-09-18 (after the seat's reading of PR #18971: 31 files, +238,310 / −119, of which 18 generated files carry +237,706 and 13 hand-written files +604 / −90; no human review; landed by the spec seat through the queue on a contract-review record). The three options, verbatim:

> - **A. 保留,尽快接线**:#18976 落地,让分片 diff 成为条款②信号。成本是 12 MiB 长期留在仓库,收益取决于复核员认真读 diff。
> - **B. 生成器保留,快照移出仓库**:CI 里对上一个 release tag 重新生成并 diff,把 diff 贴到 PR 上作为条款②信号;仓库里不存 12 MiB。同一个读者、同样可读,重量归零。这会改您 09-06 的裁决,所以是您的字。
> - **C. 回退这个 PR,用消费方编译代替**:objectui / cloud 对 spec@main 的编译作为唯一形状门禁。最轻,但只覆盖被消费的那部分导出。

Maintainer reply, verbatim: 「C」 (chat, 2026-09-18, about 11:33Z on the seat's clock; a chat reply carries no platform stamp). This supersedes ruling 5560224701 (director batch #60, 2026-09-06, option A) on #16045.

## What this card carries (the objectstack half)

1. **Revert PR #18971** (squash commit `d8b12fca9`). Measured by the skills seat on a scratch worktree at `origin/main` (`43f476688`): `git revert d8b12fca9` applies cleanly — 31 files, 119 insertions / 238,310 deletions; the two commits landed after it (`2767af8e8`, `43f476688`) touch none of the reverted files. The revert restores `packages/spec/api-surface-signatures.json` (the 27 hashes) as the interim shape pin, deletes `packages/spec/scripts/build-api-surface-declarations.ts` and the 17 shards, and takes back the rows PR #18971 added to `scripts/regen-artifacts.mjs`, `scripts/pm/check-widening-tells.mjs`, `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` (`CLASS_EIGHTH`), `.github/workflows/lint.yml`, `.gitattributes`, `docs/spec-generated-artifact-sharding.md` and the unreleased changeset `16045-spec-declaration-text-snapshots.md`.
2. Lanes on the revert: the subject is the spec artefact ⇒ `domain:spec` drives the PR; the `scripts/pm/**` hunks are the skills seat's to review at contract tier (it will, on the PR); `.github/workflows/lint.yml` is a workflow file. Open draft PR #18903 (skills) also touches `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs` in another region — whichever lands second merges `origin/main` first.
3. **The revert PR lands by the maintainer's hand**: under the maintainer's second ruling of the same exchange (「修改代码量超过某个行数（比如5000）就应该人工审核」, carried by the skills-lane card filed with this one), a 238,429-line PR is never a seat's landing. Open it as a draft, get it green, request review from `GOVERNED_APPROVERS`, stop.
4. ⛔ Not this card: the consumer-compile gate that replaces the snapshot — objectui's half is filed on objectui; cloud's half is NOT filed by this seat (that repository is outside this session's write scope) and is named to the maintainer in chat.

## Labels, with provenance

`domain:spec` · `priority:p1` · `pm:queue` set by the skills seat executing the maintainer's ruling (the ruling names no lane; the subject is `packages/spec`'s artefact; p1 because every clone and every spec PR pays the 12 MiB until it is gone). The triage seat may re-grade; ⛔ the direction is not re-adjudicated.
